name: hud_cmd_bind_button_base_rebuild_binding_slot_widgets
description: HudCmdBindButtonBase::RebuildBindingSlotWidgets reallocates the binding slot item array, constructs list-selector items, stores total/visible counts, and positions visible, bind-panel, and overflow rows.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja still has a documented x87/_ftol lifting limitation in this function, so tier S comparison is deferred.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b90e0 validates old count-prefixed item array destruction through ftable slot 0, new count-prefixed allocation, HudUiListSelectorItem array construction, total/visible count writes, visible row SetPos via ftable slot 3 using visible offsets and spacing, bindPanel SetPos, and overflow row SetPos using overflow offsets.

The native smoke verifies allocation/count state, visible and overflow row positions, list selector item construction state, bind-panel position, selected/overflow item metadata, and cleanup of the rebuilt slot array.
